clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Falathim, murlocs now overrun the western Ashenvale shore southwest of Maestra's Post. Night elves once came here to swim and fish, drawn by Elune's moonlight said to touch the water day and night.

Lake Falathim lies southeast of the Zoram Strand, where the Kaldorei once swam and fished in peace. Local lore says Elune's gentle light rests on the water at every hour, by day and by night. Now ferocious murlocs have surged inland and seized the shores. Their numbers drive away travelers and scholars.

Murlocs have made Lake Falathim dangerous for anyone wandering alone. The night elf scholar Teronis recently went missing near the water while pursuing his inquiry. Sentinels fear for anyone who approaches the moonlit pool alone, with hostile murlocs lurking along the banks and in the shallows.
